title: Zechariah is Stoned and Joash Murdered
description: The Spirit of God came upon Zechariah, the son of the priest Jehoiada, who warned the people that they had forsaken the Lord. He was stoned in the courtyard of the house of the Lord at the command of King Joash. At the turn of the year, a small Aramean army defeated Judah as God's judgment, and finally the severely wounded King Joash was murdered on his bed by his own servants in revenge for the blood of Zechariah.
